# Target

> Target is a general merchandise retailer offering seasonal shopping, membership programs, product categories, and deals across apparel, home, toys, and more.

Target.com serves as the primary e-commerce platform for Target's 1800+ US locations, featuring integrated loyalty programs (Target Circle, Target Circle 360), seasonal shopping hubs, and a comprehensive product catalog. The site emphasizes membership benefits, same-day delivery options through partnerships, and curated seasonal collections.

## Key Topics

- Target Circle
- Target Circle 360
- Target Circle Card
- Membership rewards
- Same-day delivery
- Seasonal shopping
- Easter shopping
- Gift registry
- Top deals
- Product categories
- Store locator
- Discount offers
- Family shopping
- Holiday promotions
- Target Circle Week

## Core Shopping & Homepage

- [Target : Expect More. Pay Less.](https://www.target.com): Target homepage with seasonal shopping, membership programs, and product categories.
- [Shop All Categories : Target](https://www.target.com/c/shop-all-categories/-/N-5xsxf): Target product catalog and category navigation for all merchandise.
- [Top Deals at Target](https://www.target.com/c/top-deals/-/N-4xw74): Target top deals and promotions across toys, electronics, and home decor.

## Membership & Loyalty Programs

- [Target Circle™](https://www.target.com/circle): Target Circle membership program with rewards, loyalty benefits, and enrollment.
- [Target Circle™️ Card: Save 5% at Target](https://www.target.com/circlecard): Target Circle Card product page with 5% savings and credit card benefits.
- [Target Circle 360™ : Target](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle-360/-/N-2rguk): Target Circle 360 premium membership with same-day delivery and Shipt benefits.

## Seasonal & Holiday Shopping

- [Easter 2026 : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter/-/N-5xt1n): Easter seasonal shopping hub with decorations, treats, and gift ideas.
- [Easter Candy | Chocolate, Jelly Beans & Basket Treats](https://www.target.com/c/easter-candy/-/N-55910): Easter candy selection including chocolate, jelly beans, and basket treats.
- [Easter Decorations : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-decorations/-/N-4uswe): Easter decorations including wreaths, table decor, and spring yard items.
- [Easter Outfits : Shop Stylish Looks | Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-outfits/-/N-4xwcj): Easter clothing and spring fashion for families including dresses and suits.
- [Easter Basket Ideas 2026 : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-basket-ideas/-/N-ovmzr): Easter basket gift guide with candy, toys, books, and small gifts.

## Easter Specialty Items

- [Easter Egg Fillers : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-egg-fillers/-/N-41076): Easter egg fillers including toys, stickers, and candy options.
- [Easter Stuffed Animals : Target](https://www.target.com/c/easter-stuffed-animals/-/N-a7rre): Easter stuffed animals including Squishmallows and plush toy options.
- [$5 & Under Easter Finds : Target](https://www.target.com/c/-5-under-easter-finds/-/N-ttl9r): Budget-friendly Easter finds under $5 with seasonal deals and gift ideas.

## Customer Services & Tools

- [Gift Registry & Wish lists : Target](https://www.target.com/gift-registry): Gift registry and wish list creation for weddings, baby, and special occasions.
- [Stores Near Me : Target](https://www.target.com/store-locator/find-stores): Target store locator with hours, directions, and 1800+ locations across US.

## Optional

- [Easter Crafts](https://www.target.com/c/easter-crafts/-/N-yz6n8): DIY Easter craft ideas and supplies for kids' activities and decorations.
